title: Jamstack
by: Netlify, with community contributions on GitHub
summary: The home of the Jamstack definition, with a glossary, videos (Jamstack TV), the 2022 community survey and filterable directories of about 370 static site generators and 130 headless CMSs. Netlify coined the term and runs the site, so expect its framing; the directories take entries by pull request, so check how current each project is yourself.
